lead.headline: FIVE KILLED IN GUWAHATI HOTEL SHOOTING; SUSPECT ARRESTED
lead.deck: Four victims were from one family; police say a lease dispute may have led to the attack

image.alt: Hotel Bilas Inn in Guwahati after a fatal shooting
image.caption: Police said five people died and one was injured in the October 26 shooting. (India Today NE)

paragraphs: Five people, including four members of the same family, were killed in a shooting at Hotel Bilas Inn in Guwahati. A sixth person was injured and taken for treatment.
Guwahati Police said the suspect was arrested within an hour and the firearm was seized. Investigators said preliminary findings point to a dispute linked to the hotel lease.
Police said the inquiry is at an early stage, with forensic teams examining the scene and further details pending. The suspect had leased the property, according to investigators.

sidebarStory.headline: BENGALURU WASTE COLLECTION REVAMP HITS A ROADBLOCK
sidebarStory.subhead: Only five of 21 approved packages have work orders accepted; ten tenders recalled
paragraphs: The city’s door-to-door garbage collection revamp is facing delays after contractors accepted work orders for only five of 21 approved packages. Ten tenders have been recalled, with rollout potentially delayed by three to six months.

stories.headline: THREE ARRESTED IN BENGALURU JERMAIAH ROAD BLAST CASE
stories.subhead: Police allege the men conspired in an explosion at an under-construction building
paragraphs: Bengaluru Police arrested three men from Assam in connection with an October 20 explosion at an under-construction building on Jermaiah Road. Police allege the men conspired and exchanged information through a WhatsApp group.

stories.headline: CM SAYS KPSC WILL BE GIVEN A NEW FORM
stories.subhead: DK Shivakumar announces reforms for Karnataka’s public service commission
paragraphs: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar said the Karnataka Public Service Commission would be reformed, speaking to reporters at Bengaluru Palace grounds.

stories.headline: KARNATAKA CM WARNS FIRMS OVER NEGLECT OF KANNADIGAS
paragraphs: Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar warned private companies in Karnataka against allegedly sidelining Kannadigas and said the state could take action.

stories.headline: UP CEO REJECTS 26 VOTER-DELETION FORMS WITH SAME SIGNATURE
stories.deck: A booth-level officer has been booked after incomplete forms sought to remove voters in Sultanpur

image.caption: The CEO’s office said the applications were incomplete and were not accepted. (ABP Live / PTI)

paragraphs: Uttar Pradesh’s Chief Electoral Officer said 26 Form-7 applications bearing signatures under the name Nand Lal were not accepted. The forms sought removal of voters from the roll in Sultanpur.
The CEO’s office said the applications lacked required applicant details. The booth-level officer was relieved of election duties and a case was registered over the handling of the forms.

stories.headline: AAP’S SANJAY SINGH FLAGS BIZARRE VOTER ENTRIES
paragraphs: AAP MP Sanjay Singh criticised Uttar Pradesh’s voter-roll process and questioned the state election chief over entries he described as anomalous.

stories.headline: VOTE COUNTING FOR UP COUNCIL POLLS TODAY
paragraphs: Votes for the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council elections are scheduled to be counted on Tuesday, October 27.

stories.headline: GARBAGE COLLECTION REVAMP STALLED BY CONTRACTOR STANDOFF
stories.deck: Only five of 21 approved packages have been accepted, delaying a citywide overhaul
paragraphs: Bengaluru’s plan to expand door-to-door waste collection is at a standstill after contractors accepted work orders for only five of 21 packages. Ten tenders have been recalled, and the rollout may slip by three to six months.
The new system was expected to begin in Vijayanagar first. The impasse leaves the city relying on existing collection arrangements while authorities work through the tender dispute.

stories.headline: POLICE ARREST THREE IN JERMAIAH ROAD EXPLOSION
paragraphs: Three men from Assam were arrested in connection with an explosion at an under-construction building on Jermaiah Road. Police said they were investigating an alleged plot.

stories.headline: KARNATAKA EXAMS AUTHORITY RELEASES PWD TEST SCHEDULE
paragraphs: The Karnataka Examinations Authority released the schedule for written examinations for several Public Works Department posts.

stories.headline: ISRO PLANS FOUR FUNCTIONAL LAUNCH PADS BY 2029
stories.deck: Chairman V. Narayanan outlined a plan to expand India’s launch infrastructure

image.alt: Indian launch vehicle at the Satish Dhawan Space Centre
image.caption: India plans to expand launch capacity by 2029. (Representative image / Wikimedia Commons)

paragraphs: ISRO plans to have four functional launch pads by 2029, according to chairman V. Narayanan. The announcement was among the national science and technology headlines for October 27.

stories.headline: ISHAN KISHAN RULED OUT OF THIRD T20I
paragraphs: India wicketkeeper-batter Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of the third T20I against New Zealand because of a low-grade right adductor strain, the BCCI announced.
